title: Ownership, Transfer and Plan Proof — Alignment Services & Plans Reference Card
content:
**Alignment Services & Plans are tied to one vehicle and one purchaser.** No holding moves to another vehicle or another owner, every holding ends when the purchaser no longer owns the vehicle, and a vehicle carries at most one active holding at a time.

| Line | Can move to another vehicle or owner | Ends when the purchaser no longer owns the vehicle | What shows the purchaser still owns the vehicle (lifetime lines) | How a holder proves the plan at the counter | Active alignment holdings one vehicle may carry at the same time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | No | Yes | not applicable | lookup on the customer's profile | 1 |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | No | Yes | not applicable | lookup on the customer's profile | 1 |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | No | Yes | not applicable | lookup on the customer's profile | 1 |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | No | Yes | not applicable | lookup on the customer's profile | 1 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | No | Yes | the vehicle is on the purchaser's profile | lookup on the customer's profile | 1 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | No | Yes | the vehicle is on the purchaser's profile | lookup on the customer's profile | 1 |

### Questions this card answers

**Does a holder need a paper certificate at the counter?** No line asks for one: the plan is proved by looking it up on the customer's profile.

**What evidences ownership for a lifetime line?** The vehicle being on the purchaser's profile.

**Hypothetical:** a holder sells a vehicle carrying a Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan and buys another car. The plan does not move to the buyer or to the replacement car, because no line can move to another vehicle or owner and every line ends when the purchaser no longer owns the vehicle.
